verdict.rationale: Railway's own docs say cloud agents can be put to sleep, which keeps their files, or deleted, which removes their disk. That gives users direct but narrow control over retention and deletion for one class of AI-workload data. Nothing in the pack covers broader retention policies, such as log, metrics, database or backup retention periods, or account-level data deletion. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods for logs/metrics/backups, deletion controls for databases and volumes, account/data deletion policy docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Sleeping stops its processes and compute billing while retaining files; deleting the agent removes its disk.
Your files stay on the agent's disk, and the machine stays running when you disconnect.
